faq.howDoIJoinRes:
It's quick and easy! Registering with Pórtiqo takes less than 5 minutes. All you need is:

To be a resident of Europe (with your ID card, passport, or residence card).
To have a European bank account.

The process begins by clicking on “Become a customer.” During registration, we will ask you for some basic personal information, and then you will go through a quick identification process using your ID (you will need to have it handy).

In less than 5 minutes, your account will be ready, and you can start trading with ease.
faq.howMuch: How much money do I need to start investing?
faq.howMuchRes: You can invest from €1,000 in some of our funds. If you are still unsure and would like to simulate the returns you could obtain with our funds, you can access them through Google or Apple and view our entire portfolio.
faq.investmentFund: What is an investment fund and how does it work?
faq.investmentFundRes:
An investment fund is a simple way to put your money to work alongside that of other investors. A team of experts manages it and invests it in different assets (such as stocks or bonds) to take advantage of market opportunities and reduce risk through diversification.

You buy shares, which represent your stake in the fund. Their value changes every day depending on how the investments perform.
 Profits or losses are distributed among all participants proportionally.

There are two main types:

- Accumulation funds: dividends are automatically reinvested.

- Distribution funds: dividends are distributed directly to investors.

You can enter or exit the fund whenever you want (subscribe, transfer to another fund, or redeem shares), although it may take a while for the money to become available, depending on the fund.
faq.isEasyToTransferMoney: Can I transfer the money I have invested in funds on other platforms to Pórtico?
faq.isEasyToTransferMoneyRes: Of course! When you sign up for the fund, you will have the option of making your contribution by bank transfer or by transferring funds from another fund. You will just need to tell us whether the contribution is partial or total and follow the steps we indicate.
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.whenCanIRecoverMyMoney: When can I get my money back once I invest in Pórtiqo?
faq.whenCanIRecoverMyMoneyRes: Whenever you want! Just log in to your fund, select “Withdraw,” and enter the amount you want to withdraw and a deposit account.
faq.whyIsItBetter: Why do you offer better returns than other platforms?
faq.whyIsItBetterRes: At Portiqo, we specialize in selecting the best products on the market. Our experts select the best funds based on their profitability, risk, and commission costs. This allows us to offer you only those products that have historically outperformed their competitors.

preventionFraud.description:
Data provided for the formal identification of the client, analysis, and monitoring with the aim of preventing, detecting, and managing fraudulent or other illicit activities. Pórtiqo companies will implement appropriate control and supervision measures, complying with applicable regulations on fraud prevention. The purpose of the processing will be communicated to the client at the time of data collection and during registration.

  • Data collected: IP address, device information, VPN usage, information from external wallets, and any other relevant data related to the client’s connection and activity on the platform.
  • Purpose: to manage and prevent the risk of fraud in transactions carried out on the platform.
  • Legal basis: this processing is based on the company’s legitimate interest in ensuring transaction security and preventing fraudulent activities.
  • Retention period: data will be kept for the time strictly necessary to achieve the described purpose and, once concluded, will remain available to competent authorities for the legally established periods.
  • Recipients: The mentioned data will be analyzed through the external service MaxMind, a provider specialized in fraud prevention solutions. MaxMind will apply its technologies and tools to assess the risk of fraudulent activity. Additionally, information related to external wallets may be analyzed using blockchain analytics services, with the aim of detecting risk patterns or suspicious activities on the blockchain.
preventionFraud.title: PREVENTION OF FRAUD AND OTHER ILLEGAL ACTIVITIES:

preventionMoney.description:
Data provided for the formal identification of the client and investigation related to Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Counter-Terrorism Financing (CTF) by Pórtiqo companies considered obligated entities under AML and CTF regulations. The services will be identified at the time the data is collected and registered.

  • Data collected: first name, last name, ID, contact address, domicile, email, phone number, and any other data that may be necessary for the formal identification of the client and investigation related to AML and CTF, including the client’s image.
  • Purpose: formal identification of the client and investigation to comply with AML regulations.
  • Legal basis: the existing legal or contractual relationship necessary for providing the service, as well as compliance with a legal obligation.
  • Retention period: data will be kept for as long as necessary for the purpose of processing (10 years), and once completed, they will remain available to public administrations, courts, and tribunals for the legally established periods to address and defend any potential liabilities arising from the processing.
  • Data sharing and disclosure: for certain services provided by any of the Pórtiqo Group companies, and with prior acceptance of the corresponding Specific Service Terms, personal data identifying the user under Law 10/2010, of April 28, on the prevention of money laundering and terrorist financing, or any other applicable related regulation, may be shared among Pórtiqo Group companies to comply with current AML regulations. In any case, data sharing that may occur will be specified in the Specific Service Terms and must be accepted prior to using the service.
preventionMoney.title: PREVENTION OF MONEY LAUNDERING

Reports can be submitted anonymously, so the report may be submitted without the identifying or contact information of the whistleblower.
  • Purpose: management of the whistleblower channel and received reports.
  • Legal basis: compliance with a legal obligation, Law 2/2023 of February 20, regulating the protection of persons reporting regulatory violations and fighting corruption.
  • Retention period: your data will be kept for the time necessary to fulfill the purpose of processing, for a maximum period of 3 months, unless, due to the special complexity of the case, it is necessary to extend it for an additional 3 months. Once the purpose is fulfilled, your data will be blocked and kept available to public administrations, courts, and tribunals during the statute of limitations applicable to actions arising from the processing of your data. If an investigation has not been initiated, the data will be deleted in any case, after 3 months from the receipt of the communication.
  • Recipients: your data will not be shared with third parties, except when necessary to comply with legal obligations arising from the investigation process of the report.

accessAndSecurity.description:
Access to transactional services and those involving the capture of personal data is conducted in a secure environment using 128-bit SSL (Secure Sockets Layer) protocol. The secure server establishes a connection so that the information is transmitted in encrypted form. This ensures that the transmitted content is only intelligible to the User’s computer and Pórtiqo’s server.

The User can verify that they are in a secure environment if a closed padlock appears in the status bar of their browser. The security of our servers is supported by a certificate issued by COMODO RSA Domain Validation Secure Server CA. This certificate guarantees that the client is communicating their data to a Pórtiqo server and not to a third party attempting to impersonate it.
